input.prompt: ORIGINAL single interactive prop asset for a colorful post-apocalyptic mobile tower-defense game. ONE small overgrown radio relay station only, isolated on a warm off-white background. Design: squat orange-red salvage housing, small gray satellite dish on top, teal cables/vines, one tiny amber indicator light, a small teal energy core near the base. Playful casual-game cartoon style, chunky simplified shapes, clean dark outlines, saturated colors, soft cel shading, top-down/3/4 game camera, mobile-readable. The prop must look functional but improvised and reclaimed by plants. No text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no logo, no UI, no extra props, no characters. Original IP only. This exact asset will be used as the source frame for an activation animation.
